name: memory
title: Long-term memory (pgvector)
description: Semantic long-term memory for an eve agent, stored in your own Postgres with pgvector. No vector service, no extra container, no bill.
docs: Requires a Postgres with the pgvector extension available (the pgvector/pgvector image has it) and WORKFLOW_POSTGRES_URL set. Add `"#lib/*": "./lib/*"` to the `imports` map in package.json so the tools can resolve #lib/memory. Uses HNSW indexing, which is correct on an empty table — IVFFlat is not.
